written.headline: UK high court rejects Meta, TikTok and X challenge to Ofcom data requests
written.summary: London’s High Court dismissed Meta, TikTok and X’s legal challenge against Ofcom’s information notices issued under the Online Safety Act. The regulator’s request for detailed content‑moderation metrics was deemed proportionate.

written.headline: US tech stocks tumble as AI spending approaches $1 trillion
written.summary: Shares of Intel fell up to 30% and the Nasdaq dropped over 3.5% as investors worry about the $800.6 bn AI spending by major firms. Companies such as Alphabet, Amazon and Reddit also saw steep declines after earnings missed expectations.

written.headline: Google’s Suncatcher prototype satellite is online and runs Gemma 4 model
written.summary: Google confirmed that its Suncatcher prototype data center satellite, launched on October 1, is now online and communicating with ground stations. The onboard Gemma 4 language model generated a haiku about being in space as part of the initial test.

written.headline: Fujifilm to boost magnetic tape production fivefold as AI drives data archiving
written.summary: Fujifilm announced a ¥10 billion (~$63 million) investment to expand its Odawara factory and increase magnetic‑tape production capacity fivefold by fiscal 2028. The move targets rising archival demand from generative‑AI workloads and cloud providers seeking low‑cost, air‑gapped storage.

written.headline: OpenAI says it will honor robots.txt signal for AI training preferences
written.summary: OpenAI announced it will respect a shared robots.txt signal that lets website operators specify their AI training preferences to participating providers.
